 Grand Lotto prize to hit P284 million
 Rainier Allan Ronda - The Philippine Star October 19, 2026 | 12:00am 
 The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office said the prize continues to increase after no bettor guessed the winning combination 09-51-33-49-04-11, which carried a total jackpot of P277,990,409.51. Philstar.com / Irra Lising 
 MANILA, Philippines — The jackpot in the Grand Lotto 6/55 is expected to reach P284 million for tonight’s draw.
 The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office said the prize continues to increase after no bettor guessed the winning combination 09-51-33-49-04-11, which carried a total jackpot of P277,990,409.51.
 Twelve bettors matched five digits to win the second prize of P1.4 million. They will receive P116,666.66 each.
 Another 773 players won the third prize of P1.3 million.
 Lottery prizes exceeding P10,000 are subject to a 20-percent tax.
